form.notes: Form-associated (ElementInternals): submits one `name=id` entry per token (repeated names in FormData, in order), nothing without tokens or a name; resets to `defaultItems`, restores on navigation (the state carries the labels), joins <fieldset disabled>. `required` means at least one token. Enter in the open results adds a token and never submits.

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default: `items` (with `defaultItems`) is a property and every user change fires the cancelable `tct-selection-change` (with `action`, `item`, `items`) followed by the native `input` and one `change`, instead of a controlled `value` plus `onChange(items, change)`. `tokenOverflowBehavior` becomes `token-overflow` with kebab values; `hasClear` and `hasCreate` keep their meaning as attributes.

Form participation is through ElementInternals (repeated `name` entries) rather than hidden inputs, with `required` validity and restore state; pasting a list (line breaks, tabs, commas, semicolons) adds one token per entry that names a result exactly, or per entry with `has-create`, and keeps what it could not resolve in the input.

Additions, removals and pasted lists are announced through the announcer with localised messages (`@tct.tokenizer.*`); the "+N more" indicator is text, not a hover-only badge; the result count is announced once per menu; Backspace on the empty input removes the last token; focus arriving from outside lands on the input instead of walking every remove button.

`token-overflow="unfocused-layer"` is accepted but expands in place like `unfocused-inline`; upstream promotes the expanded field to the top layer over the content below (a placeholder keeps the collapsed height). Moving the box into a popover while it holds focus needs a same-size placeholder twin and its own positioning and results-popup stacking; deferred as a follow-up.

One outlined box from the Tecton input tokens holds the tokens (Tecton chip roles), the input and the end lane (busy, clear-all, status icon); the result rows and the Create entry use the same highlight and pressed fills as `tct-typeahead`, checked for contrast in light and dark.
